title: The Rincón Suite
description: A boutique surf hotel on the west coast commissioned coordinated window treatments for 24 guest rooms and three common areas. Each room received a layered system — sheer linen panels for daytime privacy and light diffusion, paired with a blackout roller for deep sleep despite the early Caribbean sunrise. Hardware finishes and fabric selections were standardized across the property while allowing subtle variation by room category.
